_comment: Edit these rates freely - cost math in results is derived from this file at race time.
Set usd_per_gib_hour to 0 to bill CPU-only.
default_vcpus / default_mem_gib are ASSUMPTIONS about what each provider hands out.
Run `sgp race --task escape` to record the machine each provider actually delivers,
then calibrate these numbers - the cost column is only as good as they are.

modal.source: modal.com/pricing Sandboxes tier, checked 2026-08-28: $0.00003942/core/sec (1 core = 2 vCPU) => $0.070956/vCPU-hr; memory $0.00000667/GiB/sec => $0.024012/GiB-hr. Adapter pins the request to cpu=1.0 core / 2048 MiB, so these defaults match what Modal bills.
